reviews.comment:
Soy socia hace muchos años del ACA.
Fui a cargar nafta, hasta ahí todo bien.
Le pedí al playero si me podía limpiar el parabrisas, me dijo que si, que tenía que esperar porque estaban usando el secador. Digo OK. Pasa el tiempo y le pregunto que pasaba que tardaba tanto?? Me volvió a decir que estaban ocupandolo. Voy a ver y reclamarlo y veo a un cliente no solo limpiando los parabrisas sino todo el auto prácticamente. Se lo pido a este señor y me dice que todavía no finalizaba. Le digo al playero si no había otro y le explico la situación y me dice que no! Que se los roban!! Por eso tienen 1 solo!! Y para colmo el que estaba limpiando su auto no era socio. Una vergüenza ACA el servicio !! Bien cuando uno se atraza en la cuota te persiguen por cielo y tierra!!

(Translated by Google)
I've been a member of the ACA for many years. I went to get gas, so far so good. I asked the attendant if he could clean my windshield, and he said yes, but that I'd have to wait because they were using the dryer. I said OK. Time passed, and I asked him what was going on, why it was taking so long? He told me again that they were using it. I went to check and complained, and I saw a customer not only cleaning his windshield but practically his entire car. I asked this man to do it, and he told me he wasn't finished yet. I asked the attendant if there wasn't another dryer and explained the situation, and he said no! They get stolen! That's why they only have one! And to top it all off, the guy cleaning his car wasn't even a member. ACA's service is a disgrace! It's great when you're behind on your dues that they hound you high and low!
